description: This file defines the Reminder_Invitee class, which manages invitee data related to reminders in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for saving, loading, and deleting invitee records, and interacts with external beans and modules.

classes.name: Reminder_Invitee
classes.description: A class representing invitees for reminders, with methods to save, load, and delete invitee data.

methods.name: saveRemindersInviteesData
methods.description: Saves multiple invitee records associated with a reminder, handling duplicates and updating existing records.

methods.name: loadRemindersInviteesData
methods.description: Loads invitee data associated with a specific reminder, optionally duplicating data.

methods.name: getInviteeName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of an invitee based on their module and ID.

methods.name: deleteRemindersInviteesMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple invitee records for a reminder, excluding specified IDs.
